name: decline-full-name
description:
A full name «Фамилия Имя Отчество» put in the given case.

The name «Иванов Сергей Петрович» in the genitive is «Иванова Сергея Петровича».

case: "genitive", "dative", "accusative", "instrumental" or "prepositional".

A full name that ends in «-на» or «-зы» is a woman's («Петрова Анна Ивановна» → «Петровой Анны Ивановны»). The surname declines by its ending («-ов», «-ин», «-ой», «-ская»…), the name and the patronymic as nouns; a surname in «-ых» or «-их» stays («Белых»), a man's surname in «-а» or «-я» declines («Глинка» → «Глинки»). The result has a capital in each word. An empty cell and a value that is not three words stay as they are.

Example: semkit read --text "Иванов Сергей Петрович" decline-full-name genitive write -
-> Иванова Сергея Петровича
Example: semkit read --text "Петрова Анна Ивановна" decline-full-name instrumental write -
-> Петровой Анной Ивановной

The step rewrites the working column; with --as NAME it writes the result to a new column NAME.

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.
